description: JUnit test class for MongoQueryBuilder with limited configuration, testing features like criteria application, sorting, limits, skips, and validation.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderLimitedTest
classes.description: Test class for MongoQueryBuilder, focusing on restrictions and defaults in query building.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by loading configuration and setting limitsConfig.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up each test case with current limits and a new instance of MongoQueryBuilder.

methods.name: createWithNullCriteria
methods.description: Tests that passing null criteria throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildWithCriteriaOnly
methods.description: Verifies that the query built contains the specified criteria.

methods.name: buildWithSort
methods.description: Checks that sorting options are correctly set in the query.

methods.name: appendDefaultSortOption
methods.description: Ensures that a default sort option is appended when none are provided.

methods.name: buildWithLimit
methods.description: Verifies that the limit is correctly applied in the query.

methods.name: buildWithSkip
methods.description: Verifies that skip value is correctly applied in the query.

methods.name: buildWithLimitGreaterThanMaxValue
methods.description: Ensures that exceeding max page size throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithLimitLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures negative limit values throw IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: buildWithSkipLessThanZero
methods.description: Ensures negative skip values throw IllegalArgumentException.
